note_as_printed: Всѣ послѣдующіе спектакли до конца сезона — безплатные.
source: Repertoire 1895-96, coronation weeks: the note is printed once, in the Малый cell of 15 May 1896; no receipts are printed for any later performance of the season (scan-checked 2026-10-13).

note_as_printed: Всѣ послѣдующіе спектакли до конца сезона — безплатные.
source: Repertoire 1895-96, coronation weeks: the note is printed once, in the Большой cell of 19 May 1896; no receipts are printed for any later performance of the season (scan-checked 2026-10-13). The 17 May «Парадный спектакль» is before the note and is not covered.
